'''Crossbows''' were primitive weapons normally used by archaic peoples who did not have the technology to build [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weapons or even [[Black-powder pistol|black-powder]] weapons.

==Description==
The crossbows fired small [[Arrow/Legends|arrow]]-like projectiles, known as spears or bolts.<ref name="TRG1-" /> The crossbow needed to be reloaded via a windlass after each shot, giving it a rate of fire that was slower than a regular [[Bow/Legends|bow]]. Variants included the Alliance [[bolt-thrower]], the [[Ewok Crossbow|Ewok crossbow]], and [[Ewok Festival of Love Crossbow]]. More powerful versions of [[repeating crossbow]]s such as the [[auto-caster]] also existed.

===Usage===
Mostly primitive species such as the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] used this weapon.<ref name="TRG1-" /> However, many professional [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]], hunters, and sportsmen included modified versions of these weapons in their arsenal, as they were absolutely silent and perfect for hunting targets, whether for task assignments or sport. As a further benefit to [[Scout/Legends|explorers]], the crossbow bolts could be manufactured by hand with a little time and effort, although the quality would depend on the one making it.
